basis.governing_question: How can Iberia Foods identify savings of 8% of its cost base without cutting service levels?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Diagnose the cost base across twelve workstreams and identify savings of 8% without cutting service levels.

gate.label: Savings sign-off
gate.decision: Does the steering group approve the savings findings and design as the final result?

architect_notes: One phase, not the two stages the brief names: twelve workstreams over two phases would exceed 12 rows, so design work sits inside Diagnostic.
No Implementation phase: the brief states assessment only, so the performance_improvement archetype's Implementation phase is dropped.
